name: Talisman of Pure Good

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

magic.attunement: by a creature of good alignment

last.text: dissolves into motes of golden light

powers.name: Fissure of Burning Light
powers.text: Magic action, 1 charge: a Fiend or Undead within 120 ft standing on the ground makes a DC 20 Dex save or falls into a fissure of light and is destroyed.

summary: A holy symbol (+2 to Cleric and Paladin spell attacks) with 7 charges that open fissures to destroy Fiends and Undead.
text: A potent emblem of goodness that burns the unworthy: touching it deals 6d6 Radiant damage to a creature of neither good nor evil alignment and 8d6 Radiant damage to an evil one, and either takes that damage again each time it finishes a turn with the talisman held or carried. A good Cleric or Paladin can use it as a holy symbol and gains +2 to spell attack rolls while wearing or holding it. It holds 7 charges. While the talisman is on you or in hand, a Magic action and 1 charge let you target a creature standing on the ground that you can see within 120 feet. If that creature is a Fiend or Undead, a fissure of searing light yawns beneath it, and unless it makes a Dexterity saving throw against DC 20 it plunges in and is destroyed without a trace before the fissure seals. Using the last charge makes the talisman scatter into golden motes of light, lost forever.
